question: What discharge capacities do the Mn-substituted LNO cathodes with 10% and with 50% Mn deliver?
rendered: According to the document, the Mn-substituted LNO cathodes with 10% and with 50% Mn deliver discharge capacities of 212 mAh g^− 1 and 164 mAh g^− 1, respectively.
